subject: Security exhibit: proposed evidence routing, SOC2 attestation, and pen-test window

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Assurance scope + pen test window for Order Form

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal asked us to confirm the security exhibit language before we finalize the Order Form. Two quick asks to help our counsel: 

1) Can you share the latest SOC 2 attestation and a short evidence matrix (what artifacts you can provide and cadence)?
2) We need explicit pen-test / inspection language and a proposed window for a staging test (approx 72 hours of coordinated access). Can you propose dates and the access model?

We'd prefer limited inspection language if possible (sampled evidence, pre-notice), but our counsel will escalate if the MSA allows broad inspection.

Appreciate a short playbook we can pass along — Rebecca

--
Rebecca Lin
Director, Security & Procurement
WellnessCo

Subject: RE: Assurance scope + pen test window for Order Form

Rebecca — thanks for the clear asks. High level response and attachments below. Short version: we can provide SOC 2 Type II (most recent report), a scoped evidence matrix with weekly snapshot cadence, and a limited pen-test access window with an agreed staging environment and least-privilege data sampling.

Attached: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, pen_test_window_template.docx (sample schedule + responsibilities)

Proposed:
- SOC 2: we'll share the attestation and SOC 2 report via secure Drive link (I will share in a follow-up).
- Evidence cadence: weekly snapshot uploads (Wednesdays) for standard artifacts (configurations, access logs, change logs). For higher-sensitivity asks we can provide ad-hoc artifacts within SLA.
- Pen test window: propose June 21–25, 2027 for a coordinated staging test. Access: temporary staging accounts + timeboxed VPN jumpbox. No continuous inspection; inspection limited to predefined artifacts and sampled sessions.

Laura/legal — looping you in for any redlines to the security exhibit and suggested wording for the Order Form. If we push limited-inspection language, we should define: notice window, scope (non-PII systems), sampling bands, and escalation path.

Next steps: Laura to propose redlines; I'll coordinate proposed language back to Rebecca and confirm dates with infra.

Thanks —
Priyom Das

Subject: RE: Assurance scope + pen test window for Order Form

Thanks Priyom / Rebecca —

I've reviewed the high level. Attached is a redline with picks on the key clauses (redline_security_exhibit.docx). Key legal points: 

1) Audit rights: push to a limited-inspection model. Recommended language: "Customer may request inspection of limited, predefined artifacts and log extracts; full live inspection or on-demand access is reserved for incidents or law enforcement processes."
2) Notice & windowing: require a minimum 14-calendar-day notice for scheduled penetration tests; limit to a 5-calendar-day window unless otherwise agreed.
3) Scope carveouts: production environments are out of scope unless explicitly agreed; prefer staging/sandbox access with sanitized data.
4) Evidence cadence: accept weekly snapshots for standard operational artifacts; provide escalation clause for evidence requests tied to specific SOC 2 control evidence (with legal review).

If Sales needs a commercial concession for the customer to accept limited inspection language (e.g., a 30% one-time onboarding credit), flag it and I can route for approval.

Monica — can you confirm we have the staging access checklist and the list of artifacts we can safely share without redaction?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Rebecca — thanks for the patience. Per internal review we've agreed the following playbook for inclusion in the Order Form / Security Exhibit: 

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report via secure Drive link. Access will be time-limited and require NDA acceptance by the reviewer. (Drive link shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_soc2_attestation)

- Evidence cadence: weekly operational snapshots (Wednesdays) for standard artifacts (deployment manifests, access logs, change tickets). Requests for deeper artifacts tied to SOC 2 control mapping will be handled via evidence request ticketing, with a 5 business day SLA for standard items and legal queued for anything requiring redaction.

- Pen test / inspection: confirmed staging window June 21–25, 2027. Requirements: 14-calendar-day notice for any test; staging environment use only; sanitized data; timeboxed access via jumpbox; coordinated Page-of-Contact from both sides. No continuous live inspection.

- Audit rights language: limited inspection (artifact-only, sampled) with incident/legal escalation path. We will propose the specific wording Laura attached in the redline.

Attachments: OrderForm_Redline_20270527.pdf (proposed Order Form exhibit w/ redlines), redline_security_exhibit.docx (legal picks), evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (artifact mapping).

Next steps: 
1) Rebecca: confirm the June dates on your side and provide the PoC for your test team.
2) Laura: if redline is approved, please consolidate and I will send the consolidated Order Form to WellnessCo for signature.
3) Monica: please share the staging checklist and sanitize plan to Rebecca.

Happy to jump on a 30-min alignment call if helpful.

Best —
Priyom
